question: How long does shipping take?
reply: Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days within the continental US. Express shipping takes 1 to 2 business days. Orders placed before 2 pm Eastern time on a business day ship the same day.
keywords: shipping, delivery, how long, arrive, days

question: Do you ship internationally?
reply: Yes. We ship to the UK, the EU, Canada, Australia and Japan. International delivery takes 7 to 14 business days. Customs duties and import taxes are charged by the destination country and are paid by the recipient on delivery.

question: How do I track my order?
reply: When your order ships we email you a tracking link. You can also sign in to your account and open Orders to see the carrier, tracking number and latest status for every order.
keywords: tracking, track, where, order, package, shipped

question: What is your return policy?
reply: You can return unused items in their original packaging within 30 days of delivery. Start a return from Orders > Return items in your account and we will email you a prepaid return label. Final-sale items and gift cards cannot be returned.
keywords: return, returns, refund, send back, policy

question: How long do refunds take?
reply: Once your return reaches our warehouse we inspect it within 2 business days and issue the refund to your original payment method. Your bank may take another 3 to 7 business days to show the credit.
keywords: refund, money back, how long, credit

question: Can I cancel or change my order?
reply: You can cancel or change an order within 1 hour of placing it from Orders > Cancel order. After that the order is already being packed; let it arrive and start a free return instead.

question: How do I change my shipping address?
reply: If the order has not shipped, update the address from Orders > Edit address within 1 hour of ordering. If it has already shipped, use the carrier's tracking page to request a redirect. For your saved address, go to Account > Addresses.
keywords: address, change address, shipping address, wrong address

question: I forgot my password. How do I reset it?
reply: Click Sign in > Forgot password and enter your account email. We will send a reset link that is valid for 30 minutes. If it does not arrive, check your spam folder, then try again.
keywords: password, reset, login, sign in, account

question: Which payment methods do you accept?
reply: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal, Apple Pay and Google Pay. Business customers can request invoice payment with 30-day terms.
keywords: payment, pay, methods, card, paypal, invoice

question: What does the warranty cover?
reply: All products carry a 1-year warranty against manufacturing defects. If an item arrives damaged or stops working because of a defect, reply with your order number and a photo and we will send a replacement or refund.

question: Can I exchange an item for a different size or color?
reply: Yes. Start a return for the item you have and place a new order for the one you want. Exchanges are free within 30 days of delivery.

question: How do I get an invoice or receipt?
reply: Every order confirmation email is your receipt. For a VAT invoice, sign in and open Orders > Download invoice. Invoices show the VAT number you saved under Account > Billing.
